'''Karazak''' was the primary [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Karazak system/Legends|Karazak system]] of the [[Sujimis sector/Legends|Sujimis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Its surface was riddled with tunnels and caves which the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]] used as a base of operations. Along with [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] and the [[Thalassian system]], Karazak was one of the Outer Rim's slavery capitals.
